body.description: Generic 16-channel/8-zone distributed audio amplifier with per-zone IR and 20 A captive-cord service.
The densest template in the catalog — proves the ground lug is a real conductor and the phono ground path prints on the schedule (AC-034/m21).
Carries eight of the ten ctl.* families the product ships — the IR and RS-232 requirement-4 types are reachable without a second control device.
ARC on HDMI 1 is the only mechanism for audio travelling up a link whose defaultDirection is source->sink.
One ceiling location, one 16/4 pull, four conductors, one gesture — the canonical atomicConnect case (AC-053, RJ-016).
The AP and the camera together make NET-001 meaningful: eight class-4 PDs against a switch budget well below ports x max class.
ctl.cresnet and ctl.lutron_qs both ship topologyFree: true — Lutron QS is 2000 ft on 12 AWG; Cresnet is limited twice over (data length and 24V power drop).
Redundant dual PSU — two inlets means outletsConsumed: 2, and the chip strip outlet rollup depends on every template being honest about that.
Rear ports are 110 punchdown, not RJ45 — modelling both faces as RJ45 is the error that makes the Termination Schedule wrong on the one column the trim tech actually needs (AC-025).
Sequence step and delay are carried per outlet; SEQ-001 (v1.2) reads them — amplifiers must be last-on/first-off or a reversed sequence thumps and blows drivers (AC-033).
A container: hosted devices consume zero additional RU. Containment is child->parent only (CR-029) — the shelf carries no list of its own.
